issues.finding: Permission denial is combined with unmatched evidence filtering and renderBudget=1. The assertion !visible(a) does not isolate non-disclosure caused by permission: the evidence filter hides otherwise available non-focus a as well. complete=false checks a recorded incomplete result but does not independently establish protection of the field value.
issues.evidence: e_acceptance.mjs:65–66 combines renderBudget=1/evidence=[unmatched] with canRead(ref)=selector!=a; assertions preserve analysis, permissionId, !visible(a), complete=false and unchanged packet. select.ts:135 filters otherwise available non-focus objects by evidence; :185 marks incomplete for permission/source_status/query/render budgets, not for evidence_filter. No isolated allow-vs-deny non-disclosure comparison is part of this case.
issues.impact: This gate supports scope separation/immutability under the combined scenario; it must not be promoted to an independent runtime proof of authorization enforcement. No observed authorization bypass is alleged. Product source has canRead guards. complete excludes evidence_filter as an incompleteness reason, so this review does NOT assert that removing every guard would necessarily leave the test green.
issues.required_followup: Add an isolated host contract case: same unfettered render/evidence plan with allow shows a and its value; deny-a must not expose a value and must expose permission omission/status. Preserve denial placeholders if contract permits them. Separately test visibility-only filter with allow leaves analysis membership and canonical data unchanged. No need to repeat unchanged unrelated suites.
issues.requirement: Owner PASS4 separates UI visibility, analysis scope and permissions; metamorphic changes should isolate the claimed invariant.
